content.rendered: Middleton Family Carnival is Friday, May 11th  from 4:00-8:00.  You will not want to miss out on attending this fun event.  It will be an evening filled with games, inflatables, face painting, food, and so much more  along with a student art show display.  Fun for all ages.  We hope to see you there.
